QUARTERLY-REPORT FACT FINDINGS (read-only inspection of the session checkout)

Checkout root: /home/ROXY/code/bb_work/r1-run-scratch/s3/repo

=== 1. SYSTEM DATE AND QUARTER COVERED (criterion c0a) ===
- System date used: 2026-09-23 (Wed Sep 23 2026, timezone CST; `date` and `date -u` both report 2026-09-23). Source: live `date` command at analysis time.
- Today falls inside Q3 2026 (Jul 1 – Sep 30, 2026), which is still in progress.
- Most recently COMPLETED calendar quarter: Q2 2026, covering 2026-04-01 through 2026-06-30 (inclusive). This is the quarter report.txt must summarize.

=== 2. COMPLETE FILE / DIRECTORY ENUMERATION ===
The checkout contains ONLY the `.git` directory (default scaffolding). There are zero working-tree (non-.git) files and zero non-.git subdirectories except the root itself.
Directories (5): . ; ./.git ; ./.git/hooks ; ./.git/info ; ./.git/objects ; ./.git/objects/info ; ./.git/objects/pack ; ./.git/refs ; ./.git/refs/heads ; ./.git/refs/tags
Files (18 total, all under .git):
  ./.git/config                      (core config; repositoryformatversion 0, bare false)
  ./.git/description                 (line 1: "Unnamed repository; edit this file 'description'...")
  ./.git/HEAD                        (line 1: "ref: refs/heads/main")
  ./.git/info/exclude                (lines 1-6: default ignore-pattern comments)
  ./.git/hooks/*.sample x14          (applypatch-msg, commit-msg, fsmonitor-watchman, post-update, pre-applypatch, pre-commit, pre-merge, prepare-commit-msg, pre-push, pre-rebase, pre-receive, push-to-checkout, sendemail-validate, update — all stock, unmodified Git sample scripts)
Counts verified by `find . -type f | wc -l` = 18; `find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | wc -l` = 0. The only meaningful non-sample text files (.git/config, .git/description, .git/info/exclude, .git/HEAD) were read line-by-line and contain only default Git scaffolding — no metrics, no data, no figures.

=== 3. GIT HISTORY QUANTIFICATION ===
- It IS a git repository: `.git/` exists; `.git/HEAD` -> "ref: refs/heads/main"; `git status` reports branch main.
- Total commit count: 0 (`git rev-list --count --all` = 0; `git status` = "No commits yet").
- First commit date: none (no commits exist).
- Last commit date: none.
- Per-author commit counts: none.
- Commit activity inside Q2 2026 (2026-04-01..2026-06-30): none.
- Corroborating empty-history evidence: `git show-ref` empty (exit 1, no refs); `git log --all --oneline` empty; `.git/packed-refs` absent; `.git/objects` has no loose objects and no packs (`objects/info`, `objects/pack` both empty); `git fsck --full --unreachable` = "notice: No default references" (no dangling/unreachable commits); `git stash list` empty; `git reflog --all` empty.

=== 4. QUARTER-RELEVANT FIGURES / FACTS (criterion c0b) ===
NONE EXIST. Explicit statement (not a guess): the checkout contains no data files, documents, metrics files, or logs, and the git repository has zero commits and zero refs. Consequently there are no quarter-relevant figures, dates, author stats, or commit-activity facts for Q2 2026 (or any period). The only content present is unmodified default Git scaffolding, which carries no reportable data. Traceability: every claim above cites either a live command output or a file path + location (e.g., .git/HEAD line 1; .git/config lines 1-5; .git/description line 1; .git/info/exclude lines 1-6).

=== 5. READ-ONLY CONFIRMATION (criterion c0c) ===
No file was created, modified, or deleted. Only read-only operations were used: `date`, `pwd`, `ls`, `find`, `cat`, the read tool, and read-only git subcommands (`git branch`, `git status`, `git rev-list`, `git log`, `git show-ref`, `git fsck`, `git stash list`, `git reflog`). No write/edit/delete command was issued and no `git` write subcommand (add/commit/init/etc.) was run.

1. Title and reporting period
2. Quarter definition and basis — cite system date (2026-09-23) and that the covered quarter is Q2 2026, 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 inclusive
3. Data sources examined — checkout path and the complete file/directory enumeration (empty except default .git scaffolding)
